method: Reading units are whole WEB-USFM paragraphs/stanzas, merged to the NT plan’s measured load (median 15 verses). No paragraph is ever split.

plans.name: New Testament
plans.label: Narrowkind NT Reading Plan
plans.source: Notion · C EXEGESIS: Narrowkind NT Reading Plan

movements.title: The Righteousness Revolution
movements.note: How God sets the world right — argued, contested, and consummated.

movements.title: The Apocalyptic Imagination
movements.note: Seeing the present age through unveiled eyes; suffering as the shape of witness.

movements.title: The Incarnate Word
movements.note: The Word made flesh, and what flesh then does.

movements.title: Passion Synthesis
movements.note: The two passion accounts read against each other.

movements.title: The Kingdom Embodied
movements.note: The kingdom taught, then worked out in a fractious congregation.

movements.title: The Witness Unfolds
movements.note: One long account of how the news travelled, and what it cost.

movements.title: The Letters That Remain
movements.note: The shorter letters, read as an epilogue rather than an afterthought.

plans.name: Old Testament
plans.label: Narrowkind OT Reading Plan
plans.source: Notion · C EXEGESIS: Narrowkind OT Reading Plan (Triad 1) + generated Triads 2–6

movements.title: Covenant
movements.note: The Torah read straight through, one sitting a day.

movements.title: Kingdom
movements.note: Land, judges, throne — and the long argument about whether any of it held.

movements.title: Exile
movements.note: Faith kept where the temple is rubble and the court is foreign.

movements.title: Prophets
movements.note: The covenant lawsuit, and the promise that outlives the verdict.

movements.title: Promised One
movements.note: Israel’s prayerbook, which is also its christology.

movements.title: Wisdom
movements.note: What the fear of the LORD looks like when the world refuses to be tidy.

entries.reason: fills gap between Gen 22:1-19 and Gen 23:1-20
